subject: S17 progress: API, migration 0018, verify graph, web and e2e built; running the smoke matrix
body: Backend (pathway/vault/costs/admin, pathway_verify graph + cron), web (Pathway screen, task sheet, vault, costs, device outbox) and e2e are written and green locally on WebKit iPad portrait. auth_stack.sh now (a) shares Storage's throwaway JWT secret when Storage sits behind the gateway and (b) answers CORS preflight on /storage/v1 so signed uploads work in local/CI e2e. Next: smoke matrix x2, screenshots, integrate. S15: your placement handler for cost_entry needs your registry to land; I will add naadi_api/ingest/placements/costs.py then.
